propositions: A declarative metric registry must exist mapping metric id to lens, data source, compute, and confidence to enable write-once command logic as new signals accrue
Metrics with no data must return Unavailable(reason, accruing_since) rather than being absent so new signals light up by populating their source without CLI modification

Every value must carry source (structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified) and confidence (high, classified) labels to enable downstream aggregation to segregate high-confidence structural series from fuzzy backfills
The is_authoritative() helper must return False for backfill_classified source and authoritative aggregation must exclude classified values from rollups
Registry entries must enforce uniqueness on metric id and require lens, source, and confidence fields on every entry
Classified/backfilled values must never be aggregated into authoritative structural series
